title: Item Group Creator
description: Create custom groups in the creative inventory, with support for NBT and items from other mods.
body:
# Item Group Creator
**Item Group Creator** is a Fabric mod designed to allow, through **JSON** files within the mod's own resources, both on the client and server side, the addition of new sections in the creative inventory.


## What can you do?
- Create new inventory groups with custom names and icons.
- Include items from any mod.
- Include base Minecraft items.
- Configure specific NBTs for items.

These sections are fully configurable and support NBTs and items from other mods, allowing you to organize all your content.

## Important version note
Be careful with Minecraft versions:

In **1.21.1**, item components use square brackets [...]

In **1.20.4** and below, items use classic NBT {...}

> Note: Each example below is already adapted to its correct version. Make sure you use the correct format for your server/version, otherwise items may not work or groups may fail to load.

## Configuration path
To create your own groups, place the JSON files in the following path:

```
data/itemgroupcreator/groups/
```

> Note: The inner folder `/groups` is where the mod looks for the different item **JSON** files when starting the game or server.

## Group example 1.20.4

```
{
  "id": "groupcreator:basic_tools",
  "name": "Basic Tools",
  "icon": "minecraft:iron_pickaxe",
  "items": [
    "minecraft:wooden_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:stone_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:iron_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:diamond_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:golden_pickaxe"
  ]
}
```

## Group example with NBTs 1.20.4
```
{
  "id": "groupcreator:adventure_items",
  "name": "Adventure Items",
  "icon": "minecraft:blaze_rod",
  "items": [
    "minecraft:blaze_rod{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Fire Wand\",\"italic\":false}'}}",
    "minecraft:ender_pearl{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Teleport Wand\",\"italic\":false}'}}",
    "minecraft:shield{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Protective Shield\",\"italic\":false}'}}",
    "minecraft:arrow{display:{Name:'{\"text\":\"Arrow\",\"italic\":false}'}}"
  ]
}
```

## Group example 1.21.1

```
{
  "id": "groupcreator:basic_tools",
  "name": "Basic Tools",
  "icon": "minecraft:iron_pickaxe",
  "items": [
    "minecraft:wooden_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:stone_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:iron_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:diamond_pickaxe",
    "minecraft:golden_pickaxe"
  ]
}
```


## Group example with NBTs 1.21.1

```
{
  "id": "groupcreator:adventure_items",
  "name": "Adventure Items",
  "icon": "minecraft:blaze_rod",
  "items": [
    "minecraft:blaze_rod[minecraft:custom_name='{\"text\":\"Fire Wand\",\"italic\":false}']",
    "minecraft:ender_pearl[minecraft:custom_name='{\"text\":\"Teleport Wand\",\"italic\":false}']",
    "minecraft:shield[minecraft:custom_name='{\"text\":\"Protective Shield\",\"italic\":false}']",
    "minecraft:arrow[minecraft:custom_name='{\"text\":\"Arrow\",\"italic\":false}']"
  ]
}
```
> **Note**: When starting the game or server, the console will indicate which groups were created successfully and which were not.
